claims.text: Over the 7 days from the patch, the positive share was +14.2 points against the interrupted time series estimate of what it would have been without the patch (90% range -11.1 to +39.6). That isn't enough to credit the patch: its 90% range includes no change at all.
During the window, there were 0 sale days and price status was unknown.
Off-topic negative review mentions remained flat with a change of 0.0 percentage points.
Composition change contributed 0.08 points to the review sentiment shift.
Performance negative mentions rose by 12.78 percentage points in the window compared to the baseline.

report.summary: Over the 7 days from the patch, the positive share was 14.24 points against the estimate, which is not enough to credit the patch. Off-topic negative review mentions remained flat with a change of 0.0 pp, while composition change contributed 0.08 points to the sentiment shift. Performance negative mentions rose by 12.78 percentage points in the window compared to the baseline, and there were 0.0 reviews on sale days. The patch and a price change or sale are inconclusive, while off-topic reviews or a review bomb, a change in who reviewed, and noise or seasonality are rejected.
